lead: Mohammad Azharuddin has built a public profile as an Indian politician, born on 8 February 1963 in Hyderabad.
As of 2026, he is 63 years old, and his birth date places him under the Aquarius sign.
He has represented India national cricket team and Hyderabad cricket team and has held the office of Member of the 15th Lok Sabha.

sections.heading: Mohammad Azharuddin — Career and Professional Work
paras: Mohammad Azharuddin works primarily as a politician and cricketer.

On the team sheet, Mohammad has been associated with India national cricket team (from 1984 to 2000), Hyderabad cricket team (from 1981 to 2000), South Zone cricket team (from 1983 to 2001) and Derbyshire County Cricket Club (from 1991 to 1994).
He has held the following offices: Member of the 15th Lok Sabha (2009–present). He is affiliated with Indian National Congress.
